summary: Technical Lead with 11+ years of experience designing and delivering cloud-native applications across the complete software development lifecycle. Proven track record leading distributed engineering teams, modernizing .NET platforms, and delivering reliable integrations across Microsoft Azure, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, and enterprise systems. Strong hands-on background in C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, microservices, event-driven architecture, automated testing, and mobile-enabled workflows.

bullets.text: Lead a 12-member engineering team delivering .NET Core and Azure solutions for field service, workflow automation, and customer operations platforms
Defined microservices, CQRS, and event-driven integration patterns that reduced release dependencies and improved service availability to 99.9%
Established engineering standards for code review, automated testing, observability, and secure Azure deployments across four product teams
Partnered with product and business stakeholders to convert complex operational requirements into measurable delivery plans and technical roadmaps
Designed and implemented REST APIs, background jobs, and Azure integrations for enterprise systems processing more than 2 million monthly records
Migrated legacy ASP.NET MVC workloads to ASP.NET Core services with Entity Framework and SQL Server, improving deployment frequency and maintainability
Built integrations between Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, and third-party systems using Web API, Logic Apps, and Service Bus
Introduced NUnit, MSTest, Moq, and NSubstitute test practices that increased regression coverage for critical business workflows
Delivered web applications and service integrations using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Entity Framework, jQuery, and SQL Server
Built responsive mobile workflows with Ionic, Angular, and Xamarin Forms for field operations and internal approval processes
Created an IoT monitoring prototype using Arduino, NodeMCU, MQTT, Azure IoT Hub, and Stream Analytics

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering

projects.name: Field Service Resource Optimization Platform
projects.description: Led the modernization of a map-driven scheduling platform that matches field resources with service requirements using location, availability, and timing constraints. Owned architecture decisions, technical delivery, and integration reliability for a 12-member team.

projects.name: Candidate Compliance Workflow Platform
projects.description: Designed a modular workflow platform for tracking background verification and compliance activities. Introduced service boundaries, asynchronous processing, and operational dashboards for high-volume customer workflows.

projects.name: Enterprise CRM and ERP Integration Hub
projects.description: Built reliable interfaces between Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, and partner systems. Added retry handling, monitoring, and secure message-based processing for business-critical integrations.

projects.name: Warranty Management Platform
projects.description: Delivered a web and mobile warranty tracking solution integrated with Salesforce CRM, enabling customer service teams to manage product claims and service history from a shared workflow.

projects.name: Temperature-Controlled Inventory Monitoring
projects.description: Built an IoT prototype that captured temperature telemetry, evaluated threshold breaches, and raised corrective-action tickets in Dynamics 365 CRM for temperature-sensitive inventory.

projects.name: Executive Purchase Order Mobile App
projects.description: Created a mobile approval workflow that gave regional and executive users visibility into purchase orders and enabled decisions across multiple business units.
